propositions.text: backoff_delays returns a list with exactly `retries` elements, ordered from the first attempt (index 0) to the last.
The delay at index i is min(cap, base * factor ** i).
No returned delay ever exceeds cap; the cap is an absolute ceiling.
The delay grows by the constant multiplicative factor on each successive attempt until it is clamped to cap.
The schedule is deterministic with no jitter or randomness; identical arguments yield identical lists.
When retries is 0, the function returns an empty list.
Once an attempt's uncapped delay meets or exceeds cap, every later delay in the list is also cap.
